title: kate-search: search one file on disk
summary: search_file reads a file, refuses a binary one, builds a TextBuffer from its text, and returns one FileHit per match with the path, the line, the column, and the text of that line. The search in files pane calls it for each project file.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. The crate is pure Rust and builds anywhere. The backlog marks this title LOCAL so the Mac lane keeps the panes and their models together.
